description: Applies the Schengen 90/180-day rule to past and planned stays: days used and left, the longest possible stay, and the earliest date a trip of a given length fits.

defaultPrompt: I was in France from 1 July to 15 August and in Italy from 1 to 20 September. How many Schengen days do I have left?
I was in Spain all summer. I want to spend 60 days in Portugal this winter. When is the earliest I can go?
Spain 1 March – 10 May, Portugal 1 June – 15 July: was I over the 90/180 limit?
interface.longDescription:
Flippto Visa Calculator applies the Schengen 90/180-day rule to short stays in the 29 Schengen countries.

What it does:
- Counts the days used and left on a given date, based on the stays you describe (entry and exit days both count).
- Shows the longest continuous stay possible from an entry date and the next day that frees up.
- Checks whether a planned trip of a given length fits and, if not, finds the earliest date it would.
- Flags stays that exceed 90 days in any 180-day period.
- Shows the result as a card with a 180-day timeline and each stay with its country flag, plus a link that opens the same stays on flippto.com.

Who it is for: travellers, remote workers and anyone planning several trips to Europe under the short-stay rule.

Limitations: covers only the Schengen short-stay rule (90 days in any 180). It does not cover long-stay visas, residence permits, visa application requirements, bilateral agreements or countries outside the Schengen Area (e.g. the UK, Ireland, Cyprus). It works only with the dates given in the conversation and does not store them. Results are estimates, not legal advice; border authorities make the final decision.

name: flippto-visa-calculator
